## A new beginning.

Since 2015, designers have picked their fonts with RightFont. 2026.1 rebuilds it from the ground up — fast with 200,000 fonts, previews in your own designs, and one library for your whole team.

### Preview in Your Design

Select one or several text layers or frames in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Sketch or Figma. RightFont sets every font in your library in your actual layout, next to the original, with your colors, sizes, spacing and OpenType settings.

- Frame the whole artboard or page, just the text, or an area you choose
- Search and filter as usual; the design follows you
- Click Apply on a card to set its font — until then, your file is untouched

- Fonts whose version differs from the document are pointed out
- Activated fonts follow their files when they move, and switch off when deleted

### Every detail of a font

The Info panel shows a font up close — glyphs with their outlines, variable axes and named instances, and OpenType features — and works with several fonts or a whole family at once.

- Compatibility notes for Adobe apps, PDF export and the font file itself
- Metrics checks and the font’s technical tables
- Pinch to zoom previews on a trackpad
